item.title: Troubleshoot Email Delivery
item.description: Layer5 Cloud sends two kinds of mail. Application mail (invitations, notifications, welcome mail) leaves the Layer5 Cloud server, through an organization’s own mail server when one is turned on, and otherwise through the shared mail server you configure in the chart’s smtp values. Identity mail (email verification and account recovery) is produced by Kratos and reaches the same server only when you select the HTTP courier. See Plan a Deployment. This guide helps you find which of those paths is failing and why.
